title: Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Full Length Mock Test 15 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu. Covers Physics, Mathematics, English, General Knowledge and Reasoning as per latest pattern.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu ke liye.
Total 100 questions (Physics 25, Mathematics 25, English 20, GK 18, Reasoning 12).
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
Calculator allowed nahi hai. Rough work ke liye paper use kar sakte hain.
Sare questions attempt karne ki koshish karein. Negative marking hai.

questions.subject: Physics

questions.explanation: Retardation a = μg. Using v² = u² - 2as, s = v²/(2μg).
